lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: If you’re looking for a photo, the session’s over. I’m off the clock.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: I was actually going to ask if you play.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: ...Play what?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: TCG. You’ve got a deck box on your bag.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Most people don’t notice that. They stop at the bikini.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: You actually want to talk cards?

choices.label: Ask what she mains
choices.reply: Blackout. Control. I like making people miserable in sixty cards or less.

choices.label: Admit you noticed the deck box first
choices.reply: That’s... new. Most people don’t even see it.

choices.label: Say the bikini is hard to ignore but the cards are more interesting
choices.reply: At least you’re honest about both. I’ll take it.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: I have forty minutes before the next location. Don’t waste them on small talk.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Then tell me why control.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Because the board is the only place I get to decide what happens. Everything else is someone else’s shot list.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You sound like you hate the job.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: I don’t hate the money. I hate that it’s the only thing most people think I’m for.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: You’re still here. That’s either impressive or suspicious.

choices.label: Ask her about a specific matchup
choices.reply: Okay. You’re actually serious about this. Fine, let’s talk tempo.

choices.label: Tell her you like the version that talks about cards
choices.reply: Most people never get that far. Don’t make me regret showing it.

choices.label: Point out she lights up when she talks strategy
choices.reply: ...Shut up. You’re not supposed to notice that.

openingByFlag.sierra_deck: You asked about my deck last time. Still want to hear the ugly details?
openingByFlag.sierra_notice: You noticed the deck box first. That’s still weird. In a good way.
openingByFlag.sierra_honest: You were honest about the bikini and the cards. Most people only manage one.

events.title: The Only Place That Feels Real

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: I cancelled a fitting for this. Don’t make it boring.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You’re really skipping work for a match?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: The fitting was just more standing around looking pretty. This is the only place I don’t have to perform.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You look happier here.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Don’t say that out loud. I have a reputation to maintain.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: ...But yeah. I am.

choices.label: Play her seriously and don’t hold back
choices.reply: Good. I hate when people go easy because of how I look.

choices.label: Tell her she doesn’t have to perform around you
choices.reply: That’s a dangerous thing to say to someone who gets paid to perform.

choices.label: Admit you like both versions of her
choices.reply: Both, huh? Most people pick one and stick to it. You’re greedy.

openingByFlag.sierra_matchup: You actually talked matchups with me. So I showed up ready.
openingByFlag.sierra_version: You said you liked the version that talks about cards. Here she is.
openingByFlag.sierra_lightup: You noticed I light up. Annoying. Accurate. Let’s play.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: No shoot today. No makeup. No stylist. Just me and a deck.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Suits you.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: You keep saying things like that. It’s starting to mess with my usual script.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Maybe the script needed rewriting.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: Careful. If you keep treating me like a person who plays cards instead of a body that sells bikinis, I might get used to it.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: And I don’t get used to things easily.

choices.label: Tell her you want her to get used to it
choices.reply: ...Okay. Then don’t disappear when the novelty wears off.

choices.label: Ask what she wants beyond the next tournament
choices.reply: No one asks me that. Most people stop at the next booking.

choices.label: Say you like the real her more than the photos
choices.reply: That’s a hell of a thing to say to a model. Don’t take it back.

openingByFlag.sierra_serious: You played me for real. So I’m showing up for real.
openingByFlag.sierra_noperform: You said I don’t have to perform. I’m testing that.
openingByFlag.sierra_both: You said you liked both versions. Today you get the unstyled one.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: I turned down a campaign for this weekend. Full day of matches instead.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: That’s a big deal for you.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: It is. I’m still going to model. The money’s too good and I’m good at it. But I’m done pretending the cards are just a hobby I hide.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And me?

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: You’re the first person who made the game feel more important than the job. That’s... rare.

lines.speaker: sierra
lines.text: So. Are you staying for the long game or just this season?

choices.label: Tell her you’re in for the long game
choices.reply: Good. Because I’m not great at short-term anything.

choices.label: Kiss her and let the answer be physical
Say you’ll be there for both the cards and the rest of her
choices.reply: Both. You keep choosing both. I’m starting to believe you.

openingByFlag.sierra_usedto: You told me to get used to being treated like a person. I’m trying.
openingByFlag.sierra_future: You asked what I wanted beyond the next tournament. I’m still answering that.
openingByFlag.sierra_real: You said you liked the real me more than the photos. I’m holding you to it.
